raw:
Agent Name: Planner

Step Number: 1

Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly calculated the charge of the ion. The Planner stated that the ion has a charge of +3 when, in fact, having three more electrons than protons results in a charge of -3. Electrons carry a negative charge, so having more electrons than protons means the ion is negatively charged, not positively charged. The Planner's misunderstanding of the sign of the charge led to the wrong conclusion.
